## What changed? / O que mudou?

<!-- Briefly describe the change and link an issue if there is one. / Resuma a mudança e vincule uma issue, se houver. -->

## Why? / Por quê?

<!-- Give the concrete problem or use case. / Descreva o problema ou caso de uso concreto. -->

## Verification / Verificação

<!-- List commands you ran and the result. For UI changes, include before/after screenshots or a short recording where useful. / Liste os comandos executados e o resultado. Para mudanças visuais, anexe imagens ou vídeo curto quando útil. -->

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run validate` (or explain why a check does not apply)
- [ ] For `apps/web` changes: `npm run web:test`, `npm run web:typecheck`, `npm run web:lint`, `npm run web:build` (or explain any skipped check)
- [ ] Public-facing copy and catalog metadata are equivalent in EN/PT-BR where applicable
- [ ] No secrets, private URLs, client data, or generated artifacts added unintentionally

## Notes for reviewers / Observações para revisão
